description: Fetch funding records for an ORCID researcher: grants, contracts, awards, and salary awards. Returns funder names, funder organization identifiers, grant numbers, funding periods, and sources. Funding items come from the researcher or from member organizations such as funders, institutions, and search-and-link tools; sources names who added each. Most researchers have no funding entries even when they hold grants, so absence of funding records does not imply absence of funding. When records exist they are high-value for grant tracking and funder analysis.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

name: orcid_get_funding

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

funding.description: Funding items associated with this ORCID iD, one per ORCID funding group.

items.description: Funding item: one ORCID funding group, built from its preferred version.

endDate.description: Funding end date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

disambiguatedId.description: Disambiguated funder identifier (e.g. Crossref Funder ID URL or ROR URL).

disambiguationSource.description: Source of funder disambiguation (FUNDREF, ROR, GRID, etc.).

grantNumbers.description: Grant numbers or award identifiers for this funding record.

periods.description: Every distinct award period the funding item's versions record, ordered by start date — present only when there are two or more, such as renewals under one grant number. The other fields come from ORCID's preferred version.

items.description: Award period one version of this funding item records.

endDate.description: Period end date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

startDate.description: Period start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

sources.description: Every party that added this funding item to the ORCID record — the researcher, a funder or institution, or a search-and-link tool — one entry per distinct source in the funding group, the preferred version's first. Empty when ORCID records no source.

items.description: A party that asserted this item on the ORCID record.

assertionOriginName.description: Party the source added the item on behalf of, when ORCID records one — usually the researcher, for an item added through a search-and-link tool.

name.description: Name of the person or member organization system that added the item (e.g. a university research information system, Crossref, Scopus - Elsevier). Absent when ORCID records no name.

selfAsserted.description: True when the asserting party (the assertion origin when recorded, otherwise the source) is the requested ORCID iD; false when a member organization or another ORCID user asserted the item.

startDate.description: Funding start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

type.description: Funding type (e.g. grant, contract, award, salary-award).

url.description: URL for the funding record, if available.

fundingCount.description: Number of funding items returned, one per ORCID funding group — versions of one grant added by different sources or deposited twice count once.

notice.description: Note when no funding is found — absence of records does not mean absence of funding.

title: Get ORCID Researcher Funding
